rules: A blank or unknown rights field is not permission.
Do not mark PAIDREADY while material rights, partner approval, or disclosure requirements are unknown.
Revenue attribution requires a defined source and measurement window; do not infer revenue from views, engagement, or a CTA.
Keep platform metrics and commercial terms scoped to the individual asset or campaign.
